fixes: Disable Nagle on Android mutual-TLS clients and local relay bridges so real-time ACK and input records are not delayed.
Resolve actual focused editors in active application windows while IME temporarily owns window focus.
Hold ordered text input for up to 1000 ms after a completed gesture while WebView publishes real input focus; preserve window/gesture identity, never replay ACTION_SET_TEXT, reject unavailable focus.
assertions: Existing instrumentation assertions unchanged, including immediate WebView input, backspace, rejection without focus and delayed-ACK delta frames.
limitations: API 29/35 emulator validation, not a new physical-phone performance measurement.
The 120 ms queue expiry intentionally recovers with keyframes on high RTT; no 30 FPS claim at 150 ms RTT.
